envelope.note: Rated to 3,000 m (published). Towed at 2–6 kn; a fish is flown at 10–15% of its range above the bottom (EdgeTech's guidance).

hull.note: EdgeTech 2300 combined side-scan and sub-bottom towfish.
hull.dimensionsFrom: published: 205.9 × 81.7 × 50.8 cm (76.3 cm with the rear fins)
hull.shape: A flat aluminium sled with a tow bail and two tail fins that point it into the flow.

provenance.note: Size, weight in air and water, depth rating and the sonars' figures are EdgeTech's published datasheet. Drag, added mass and the tow cable are assumed.

addedMass.note: Assumed: half the displaced mass along, the displaced mass across and down; rotational terms small.

linearDamping.note: Assumed: small; a towfish is all quadratic drag.

quadraticDamping.note: Assumed: ½ρ·Cd·area, Cd 0.8 nose on and 1.2 side and face on.

thrusters.note: None. It is flown by the ship.

tether._: The tow cable: single armoured coax (published: digital telemetry over a single coaxial tow cable). Its size and strength are assumed.

sensors.name: side_scan
sensors.note: EdgeTech 2300 side-scan, published figures; the ping is rendered by systems/sidescan.py.

sensors.name: sub_bottom
sensors.note: Four DW-106 transducers and a PVDF array (published). Not yet simulated: it needs what lies under the seabed.
